closedTaskMenu.sourceFinding: useTaskPRUnlinkMenu runs in the row owner while the menu is closed. Its nested hooks mount seven app-store subscriptions per observed row. Move those hooks into the mounted ContextMenuContent child and retain reactive loading and unlink behavior when open.

limits: Private instance.getSnapshot and appStore.getState wrappers preserve original selected values and restore owned functions on stop.
These are observer-visible external-store queue checks. Direct render-time snapshot calls that bypass an instance queue are not counted.
Instance totals include external stores that are not the app store. appStoreChecks counts only queue checks that call the observed appStore.getState.

Group labels use a minified component name and sorted prop keys. Anonymous component types with identical prop keys can share a group. The task menu mapping uses its complete unique prop signature and compiled function body.
Root signatures name the latest observed app-state change. They do not prove which publication caused an individual check.
The intrusive probe changes scheduling. Its counts are not speed, CPU-time, INP, M2 Air, battery or heap-leak measurements.
All 300 ordered updates are verified after the observer stops. Counts need not include every update.

bundles.scope: Private observer and calibration bundles. Application source and production assets unchanged.

interpretation: Closed TaskItemWithContextMenu owners issue 125,300 app-store queue checks in the control window, all with unchanged selected values. Moving PR hooks to mounted content removes those checks. Total observation durations, state versions and commits differ. No total-count percentage or speed gain follows.
